name: Adjourned Agenda and Minutes
agenda_text:
AGENDA FOR THE
SAN DIEGO CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA FOR REGULAR COUNCIL MEETINGS
OF
MONDAY, JANUARY 5, 2026
TUESDAY, JANUARY 6, 2026
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
---------------------------
The City Council meetings of January 5 and January 6 of 2026 have been adjourned, pursuant to the 2026 Legislative Calendar adopted by Resolution 316464 on October 21, 2025.
The next regularly scheduled meeting of the City Council is Monday, January 12, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., and Tuesday, January 13, 2026, at 10:00 a.m.
